_doc: Sensor contract file. Your MCU/script writes this JSON. The edge monitor reads it every inference cycle.
_format: Either a single JSON object (latest reading) OR a JSON array (edge monitor picks the last element).

_fields.light_lux: float — ambient light in lux (e.g. 420.0); daytime ~800, night ~20
_fields.road_surface: string — one of: dry | wet | slippery
_fields.weather: string — one of: clear | rain | fog
